content.short: CoinAPI provides fast, reliable, and unified data APIs for cryptocurrency markets.
content.description: CoinAPI was established in 2017 by Artur Pietrzy to deliver fast, reliable, and unified data APIs for cryptocurrency markets. The platform is designed to provide straightforward access to real-time data, enabling users to retrieve current information as events unfold. For developers, CoinAPI offers two complementary interfaces: RESTful interfaces, a stateless API that exposes a broad range of data, and WebSocket interfaces, a stateful API that delivers real-time market data.
